lifecycle_contract: Java lifecycle port: primary-key train locking after user locking, protocol/owner/terminal checks, idempotent start/pause, active-segment closure, validated raw-content persistence, server Morse scoring, current-floor ownership and final statistics. personal-telegram covers creation, REST floor reads/push requests, start/pause/resume/end, read-back, empty logs and terminal write rejection. Only elapsed durations and derived speeds are masked; counts, accuracy and raw content remain compared.
